exposure: conception type (assisted reproductive technology vs. spontaneous conception)
cohort: The study included 36,013 twin pregnancies identified from Korean National Health Insurance Service data between October 2017 and December 2021.
finding: Twin pregnancies conceived via ART showed significantly higher risks of placenta previa, preeclampsia, GDM, emergency CS, and IUGR compared to spontaneously conceived twin pregnancies, with some risks being more pronounced in women aged 35 years or older.
mod_finding: ART-conceived twin pregnancies were associated with a higher risk of emergency cesarean section (aOR, 1.21; 95% CI, 1.08-1.34).
